worldcombat.skill.guillotine.summary: Two blades close through the locked aim plane. The first body or wall stops the clamp; an enemy takes one finite heavy hit. A finishing cue follows confirmed death.
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.description: Blades reach %2$s blocks and open %3$s degrees. Their closing edges strike the first contacted enemy once for %1$s HP; native immunity and damage reduction remain active.
There are %1$s s between the jaws opening and the clamp; every level above the target shortens it, and the target must leave the wedge in that time.
Recovery takes %1$s seconds, including after a miss.
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.wide.on: Wide form: jaw angle x1.25 and longer jaws, at the cost of a slower clamp and longer recovery - easier to catch a target that stepped aside.
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.wide.off: Narrow form: clamps sooner and recovers faster, but only catches the small patch straight ahead.
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.growth.0: From level %1$s the jaws reach %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.growth.1: From level %1$s the jaws reach %2$s blocks and open %3$s degrees, with the clamp delayed only %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.use.0: Finish a target with the shortest wind-up at contact range
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.use.1: Clamp the first reachable foe inside the wedge ahead
worldcombat.skill.guillotine.use.2: Trade timing for burst, accepting the longest recovery when it misses
On: jaw angle x1.25 and jaws x1.1 longer, at the cost of +5 ticks of clamp delay and +4 ticks of recovery - easier to catch a target that stepped aside, slower and more punishing when it misses. Off (narrow form): clamps sooner and recovers faster, but only catches the small patch straight ahead.
The companion only considers guillotine while the threat is within this distance; smaller demands contact range, larger closes in from further away.
world_combat.move.guillotine.text.miss: The jaws snap shut on air
